characters.continuity: Looney Tunes / Merrie Melodies theatrical shorts
characters.summary: Wile E. Coyote relies heavily on elaborate ACME Corporation gadgets, explosives, and traps to capture the Road Runner, almost always resulting in backfires, gravity delays, or severe self-inflicted injuries.

mechanisms: Repeated recovery from near-fatal falls and explosions

weaknesses: Extreme gullibility and over-reliance on malfunctioning ACME products
Failure to recognize gravity until looking down
limitations: ACME products frequently malfunction, backfire, or fail prematurely

sources.supports: General overview of ACME gadgets and recurring failures against the Road Runner.

feats.claim: Struggles continuously to catch the Road Runner using complex ACME traps

notableResults.note: Constantly outmaneuvered by the target, leading to self-inflicted accidents

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes a wide array of ACME devices and inventions
Constantly constructs complex traps and contraptions

unknowns: Exact level of actual intelligence outside of silent obsession with the Road Runner

characters.summary: Woody Woodpecker is a chaotic, mischievous trickster who uses his sharp beak to drill through virtually any material, combined with manic energy and slapstick traps.
weaknesses: Impulsive nature and penchant for provoking stronger adversaries
limitations: Relies mostly on physical mischief rather than structured combat training

sources.supports: Overview of Woody Woodpecker's personality and cartoon abilities.

feats.claim: Drills completely through solid metal safes and wooden structures using his beak

notableResults.note: Outsmarts recurring rival through tricks and pranks

unknowns: Exact limits of what his beak can penetrate in different continuity eras
